entities.summary: Gojong, a notable figure in the history of South Korea, associated with Korean Empire and Japanese Colonization (1897–1910). Preceded by Eulsa Treaty and Korean Empire. Their legacy influenced Japan formally annexes Korea — beginning 35 years of colonial rule and Colonial Resistance and Independence Movement.
